// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// The whole of what PR4's rotation permission allows, and the clean shape the
// blocking specs run against.
//
// The new code is minted INLINE. Nothing holds it, so no later line can return
// it to the operator, which is the failure owner amendment C1 exists to
// prevent: "an operator who can READ a family code can sign in as that family
// and see that child's jar".
//
// The update carries a select, so the updated row does not come back holding
// the very column this operation exists to avoid handing over.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { makeFamilyCode } from "@/lib/familyCodeMint";

export async function rotate(parentId) {
  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const family = await tx.parent.findUnique({
      where: { id: parentId },
      select: { id: true, email: true },
    });
    if (!family) return null;
    await tx.parent.update({
      where: { id: family.id },
      data: { familyCode: makeFamilyCode() },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return family.id;
  });
}
